attributes.coverage: PA-100K Backpack under its own annotation semantics; not shown equivalent to annotation guide 5.1. A source 0 cannot tell absent from not visible.
HandBag or ShoulderBag only; may miss totes, briefcases, shopping and carrier bags that MAVI counts. HoldObjectsInFront is never a bag.
Hat is a subset of MAVI headwear; Hat=0 is not evidence that a helmet, hood or headscarf is absent.
